title: Time Off in Lieu
subtitle: Maybe nothing will change, or maybe something will.

items.text: Time Off in Lieu

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: ...Good morning, Miss Vertin.
Good morning, Mr. Fog.
Is there anything I can do for you, Mr. Fog?

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Ahem, not really. It's only that I remembered something.
What is it?

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: It's not really worth mentioning, it's just... um...
You've taken on the title well, Fogwalker.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Oh?

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Ahem, please... please don't concern yourself with that sort of thing.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Actually, I came here for another reason.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: The day before yesterday, you mentioned an operation planned for today. One that required my participation.
Yes, I recall you refused it at the time...
items.edge_label: うん、でも断ったはずでは？

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: I... well, what I mean is, if you could... compensate me for my day off in some other way... then I might, well, that is to say it's not impossible for me to, let's say, make an exception and take on another shift.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Is that so? Well... the thing is, the matter has been resolved.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: ...Resolved?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: To be precise, on the evening of our conversation, you and Mr. Knight appear to have worked together to resolve the issue.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: When? Wait... You mean those critters?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Yes. we received word about a horde of critters in that forest known to attack humans.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Those critters would usually hide in the forest's fog during the day and only strike at night.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Therefore, I had hoped that today, during the daytime, you could absorb the fog to help us locate that particular critter horde.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: ... And why not at night?
I seem to recall you having school tonight?
items.edge_label:
だってきみ、夜は
夜間学校に行くんだよね？

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: ... Thank you, Miss Vertin, for so kindly respecting my rights to education.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Since you and Mr. Knight already handled the critter situation, there is no need for you to remain at work today.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: ... I can't help but feel something is amiss here.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: That's right!

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: What about Mr. Knight? You told me he would be unable to participate in today's operation for some reason, but that night he and I ... defeated those critters alone.
Today, Mr. Knight has taken the day off.
items.edge_label: 彼は今日休暇をとってるよ

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: A day off?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Correct. He told me he wished to spend the day paying tribute to his fallen brothers-in-arms... Men who chose to make the ultimate sacrifice in order to give hope to others.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Miss Vertin.
Hm?

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Although I still hate the fog and the other Fogwalkers just as much as I did before...

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: I feel as though I understand them a little more.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Perhaps there is nothing I can do to put an end to the fog of London.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: But if I evade my responsibilities and duties like this, then I'll surely be depriving myself of that hope.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: The hope my father died trying to preserve.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Vertin, I'm determined to clear the fog in London. Not only as a Fogwalker but also as someone who has seen the glorious light of the sun.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: ... I want to become someone who can clear the fog and bring hope to others.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: To this end, I intend to study hard and secure a place at the University of Cambridge.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: And what motivated you to make this decision?

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: I believe that, compared to pursuing a life engaged in arcanism alone, it would be better for me to become a Cabinet Secretary, guiding our nation's politicians in the formulation and regulation of our nation's laws.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Miss Vertin, why are you looking at me so strangely? Is there some unseen flaw in my plan?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No, Oliver, there's nothing wrong with it. Perhaps it's only that your plan is so fitting for you that I'm at a loss for words.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Then I shall feel honored to have your approval, Miss Vertin.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Anyway, I'll say goodbye now. I haven't finished my work for today just yet.
Goodbye, Mr. Fog.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: By the way, there was one more thing I wanted to say.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Thank you, Miss Vertin.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Oh yes, and please convey my gratitude to Mr. Knight for me.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Please tell him ... that perhaps I will never become a knight, but I will not rest until I become myself.

items.speaker: Oliver Fog
items.text: Oliver Fog, the Fogwalker of London.
THE END
